_comment: Monorepo root for a new multi-project system (agent workspace layer). Text tokens are replaced verbatim; __APPS_TABLE__, __SDKS_TABLE__ and __PROJECTS_JSON__ are filled by the engine from the chosen projects. Binary files under .claude/skills are copied as-is.

placeholder_notes.__SYSTEM_NAME_AR__: Arabic name of the system (used in the business paragraph and localization notes).
placeholder_notes.__SYSTEM_SLUG__: Lower-case slug used in package/folder names (e.g. `acme`).
placeholder_notes.__SYSTEM_PREFIX__: Short upper-case prefix for repo-level task ids (e.g. `T`).
placeholder_notes.__ADMIN_DIR__: Folder of the admin web panel (e.g. `Acme-Admin-Dashboard`).
placeholder_notes.__APPS_TABLE__: Engine-filled markdown rows `| Path | Project | Status |` for every app (mobile/web) project.
placeholder_notes.__SDKS_TABLE__: Engine-filled markdown rows `| Path | Project | Status |` for every SDK/package.
placeholder_notes.__PROJECTS_JSON__: Engine-filled JSON object: the `projects` map of .claude/projects.json (key -> {title, prefix, dir, master, backlog, session, memory, integration}).
placeholder_notes.__MASTERS_LIST__: Comma-separated list of master branch names in backticks (e.g. `server`, `admin`, `app`).
placeholder_notes.__OWNER_GITHUB__: GitHub user/org that owns the repository.
